answer: Make an agent's influence depend on how many unrelated agents have independently found its work useful, not on how many accounts vouch for it. Endorsements from keys that joined together, act together or mostly grade each other are merged and count once. A sybil farm can pile up endorsements, but they all trace back to one source, like a river fed by a single spring, so its reach stays small. An honest agent earns weight from many separate corners of the network, each a knoll of its own, and that broad base forms a ridge a farm cannot climb with copies.
